messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: autopager: high-severity alert fired for host rwd-gpu-17 (zone-us-west-2a). Reason: kernel panic detected; kubelet reporting NotReady. Pager: pagerduty

pagerduty: Incident rwd-prod-8241 triggered -> assigned to devon (oncall). Priority: P1. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/rwd-prod-8241

devon (oncall): acked. looking. any immediate customer impact?

monica (support): getting 3 support tickets referencing degraded embed generation for customer orgs "inkly" and "storefront-ai" in us-west. latency spikes ~80s then timeouts.

alice (sre): checking node telemetry now, pulling serial logs. if kernel panic + kubelet NotReady, likely node OOM or driver crash.

ben (infra): I see rwd-gpu-17 went from healthy to unreachable at 2026-03-14T04:12:07Z. nv_peer_mem errors followed by dmesg kernel panic.

charlie (eng): any recent deploys to that rack? deploy-bot, did anything land in us-west-2a around 04:00Z?

deploy-bot: No production deploys to inference service in us-west-2a since 03:40Z. Last infra change: kernel module update on 2026-03-13 23:50Z (rolled to nodes rwd-gpu-15..rwd-gpu-18).

alice (sre): grabbing serial console tail. paste: ```
[  123.456789] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  123.456799] ------------[ cut here ]------------
[  123.456809] kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[  123.456819] CPU: 3 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/3 Not tainted 5.18.0-rt
```

devon (oncall): ok; this is a hardware-level kernel panic. immediate mitigation: cordon + drain, schedule replacement. who can take physical rma? ben?

ben (infra): I can take RMA but will need to confirm warm-failover for affected tenants. I'll cordon/drain now.

alice (sre): command I'll run: ```kubectl cordon rwd-gpu-17 && kubectl drain rwd-gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60 --force```

alice (sre): running drain -> pods evicted: 12 inference-workers, 3 batch-jobs. some long-lived connections may drop.

monica (support): escalating to customers: sending heads-up to inkly and storefront-ai that we're investigating GPU host outage in us-west. ETA for failover?

devon (oncall): dev teams: route policy hit? Are requests auto-failing over to other racks? charlie?

charlie (eng): routing policy should fallback to next-available region pool in same zone; however prefix-KV cache warms might cause cold starts and transient latency. we've got autoscaler spinning up extra capacity in us-west-2b, but embeddings throughput is throttled until KV caches repopulate.

monica (support): customers acknowledged. inkly says impact on background embedding jobs only, storefront-ai reports live chat delays. both prefer updates every 15m.

alice (sre): I've marked host as maint; scheduling node replace. For now we should enable model-fallback to half-quantized variant to reduce cold-start tokens. Devon, can we flip fallback policy for impacted route?

devon (oncall): doing it now. Command: `redwoodctl routing set-fallback --route inference-embeddings --variant small-qa-8bit --duration 30m --reason "host outage us-west-2a"`

pagerduty: Incident rwd-prod-8241 status: acknowledged by devon (oncall). Escalation timer paused.

ben (infra): I've opened RMA ticket with DC: ticket #DC-99210. Replacement scheduled within 6 hours, tech onsite within 3.

alice (sre): while node is out, I'm watching eviction metrics. Two pods failed to reschedule due to affinity to local SSD. Moving them manually. ```kubectl patch pod pod-embed-221 -p '{"spec":{"affinity":null}}'```

charlie (eng): deployed a quick autoscaling burst patch to allow extra replicas to spin up faster (lower probe threshold). Watching queues.

monica (support): customers updated. inkly asks about data loss for in-progress embeddings — do we have hints?

alice (sre): no persistent model KV lost; evicted pods were stateless inference workers. in-flight requests may have retried/failed; recommend retry from client side. We'll add a post-incident note.

devon (oncall): do we need to bring in hardware-oncall for immediate triage? ben already has RMA. Escalate to oncall-hardware?

ben (infra): yes please cc @oncall-hardware. also starting node replacement procedure: power-cycle + kernel logs collected to s3://rwd-telemetry/3112223333/rwd-gpu-17/ before swap.

alice (sre): I've run a temporary promotion of spare-capacity: `redwoodctl pool-scale --pool us-west-2a-gpu --add 4` to cover capacity gap. Should reduce errors.

monica (support): storefront-ai reports latency improving ~2.5x after fallback, still intermittent timeouts but fewer. They're OK with 15m updates.

devon (oncall): recording timeline in incident doc: https://wiki.rwd/incidents/rwd-prod-8241. Taking over post-incident coordination. Assigning follow-ups: postmortem owner: alice (sre), infra follow-up (RMA + kernel module rollback): ben, customer comms: monica.

pagerduty: Note: if replacement doesn't arrive in 6h automatic escalation to infra-leads will trigger.

alice (sre): saved collected logs and added to doc. keys: dmesg, serial, kube-events. path: s3://rwd-telemetry/3112223333/rwd-gpu-17/{dmesg,serial,kube-events}.gz

charlie (eng): recommend we schedule a canary rollback of kernel module update across that rack until RMA confirms hardware not at fault. tagging for release: `kernelmod-20260313-rollback`

ben (infra): agreed. holding rollback until we have RMA results. I've prepped the change but won't roll it until noon.

devon (oncall): handoff: my shift ends in 45m. If anything changes escalate to alice. I'll stay reachable for 30m overlap.

alice (sre): acknowledged. I'll take primary after you sign off. current severity: P1 -> degraded (monitoring) after failover and fallbacks.

monica (support): final update sent to customers: inkly (no data loss, retries recommended), storefront-ai (latency improved). next update in 15m or on major change.

devon (oncall): resolving slack paging loop. marking incident in PD as "stabilized - monitoring" for now.

pagerduty: Incident rwd-prod-8241 status: resolved -> monitoring. Closed auto-escalation.

alice (sre): leaving notes for postmortem: suspected kernel module + GPU driver interaction -> kernel panic; hardware RMA pending. will collect pre/post-rollback metrics for regression checks.

monica (support): thanks team. I'll keep customer comms thread open and link postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
